description: repo-graph live view: when Claude edits a file, tell a running live view (graph_repo.py live) so the change shows at once, labelled with the tool that made it. Does nothing when no live view is running.

hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/graph-repo/scripts/live_notify.py"; IN=$(cat); for P in python3 python py; do command -v $P >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '%s' "$IN" | $P "$S" 2>/dev/null && break; done; true
